_why: REG-2363 - every registered gate whose proofs heart2 can never SAVE, and why. A proof is banked only under a byte key; a law that lists a directory itself (os.listdir / glob.glob / os.walk in the law file) or that needs history or footage (PROOF_NEEDS under .git or frames) has an input no key can name, so each of its proofs re-runs on every push it is in. Measured 2026-10-21: test_control's 27 proofs, ~4 min each, re-ran on every push of the v3783 series because the file listed directories at 40 sites - 23 of them its own temp dirs, one an unused glob. This list may only SHRINK: tv/test_the_unkeyable_laws_only_get_fewer.py fails on a law that is unkeyable and not here (naming why), on an entry that is keyable again (remove it), and on a list longer than the CEILING written in that law. The reasons are informational (line numbers dropped); membership is the verdict.
